title: Discrete-Time Survival Modelling with Dynamic Industrial Graphs for Mortgage Credit Risk
abstract: arXiv:2610.18795v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mortgage credit risk may exhibit dependence across economically connected areas, even when they are geographically distant. However, current models typically represent cross-area dependence through fixed geographical neighbourhoods, potentially overlooking economic connections that extend beyond physical proximity and evolve over time. These models may fail to capture shared risks among geographically distant but economically similar areas, and cannot describe a changing dependence of risk; it therefore risks retaining economically obsolete connections while omitting newly emerging ones. This paper uses similarities of industrial composition as a measure of economic proximity and develops a discrete-time survival model with dynamic industrial graphs to capture evolving cross-area dependence in mortgage default risk. translated_title: 基于动态产业图的抵押贷款信用风险离散时间生存模型
translated_abstract: 抵押贷款信用风险可能在经济上相互关联的地区之间表现出相依性，即使这些地区在地理上相距遥远。然而，现有模型通常通过固定的地理邻接关系来表示跨地区相依性，可能忽略了超越物理邻近性并随时间演变的经济联系。这些模型可能无法捕捉地理上遥远但经济上相似的地区之间的共同风险，也无法描述风险相依性的动态变化；因此可能会保留经济上已经过时的联系，同时遗漏新出现的联系。本文将产业结构的相似性作为经济接近度的度量，开发了一种带有动态产业图的离散时间生存模型，以捕捉抵押贷款违约风险中不断演变的跨地区相依性。所得到的图每年重建一次，使其拓扑结构和边权重都能随区域经济结构的变化而调整……
tldr: 本文提出以产业结构相似性度量经济接近度，构建每年重建的动态产业图并结合离散时间生存模型，从而捕捉抵押贷款违约风险中随时间演变的跨地区相依性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a discrete-time survival model with annually reconstructed dynamic industrial graphs, using industrial composition similarity to capture the evolving cross-area dependence of mortgage default risk.
